loadError.title: We could not load this part of your dashboard
loadError.body: This is on our side, not yours. Refresh the page in a minute. If it is still missing, tap Need help? and we will fix it.

finishOnboarding.title: Finish your welcome tour
finishOnboarding.body: Four short screens that explain how it works and set your training software.

nextStep.help: One thing to do now, picked from how far you have come. When you finish it, the next one appears here.

reason.complete_profile: We need your name, phone and date of birth before you can start.
reason.finish_get_ready: Get Ready checks your computer and software so nothing stops you halfway through the test.
reason.pass_practice: A short practice upload shows that your files reach us correctly before the real test.
reason.take_test: The free test shows where you stand in each skill area, so your training starts in the right place.
reason.take_test_resume: Your test is in progress and the timer is still running.
reason.take_test_expired: Your last attempt ran out of time. You can start a new attempt when you are ready.
reason.view_results: Your results are ready. They show your level in each skill area.
reason.view_results_grading: Your files were received and are being graded. We will show your results as soon as they are ready.
reason.watch_free_lesson: A free lesson lets you see how the training works before you decide.
reason.join_training: Training builds the skills your results showed you need most.
reason.continue_training: Pick up your training where you stopped.

tracker.title: Your journey
tracker.help: Five steps from setting up to training. A locked step opens when the one before it is done.

results.label: Results
results.desc: Your level in each skill area

locked.profile: Opens after you complete your profile.
locked.get_ready: Opens after you finish Get Ready.
locked.test: Opens after you submit the test.
locked.results: Opens after you view your results.

test.title: Free test
test.help: A diagnostic test with a timer. It is not pass or fail. It measures your skills so we can plan your training.
test.notStartedText: You have not started the test yet.
test.lockedText: Finish Get Ready first. It makes sure the test goes smoothly.
test.inProgressText: Your timer is running. Upload your files before it reaches zero.
test.timeUp: Time is up. We are closing your attempt.
test.gradingText: We received your files and are grading them. Refresh this page later to see your results.
test.expiredText: Your last attempt ran out of time before it was submitted.
test.unavailableTitle: The test is not open yet
test.unavailableText: We are still preparing it. Check back soon, or tap Need help? to ask when it opens.

training.title: Training
training.help: Lessons and exercises that start from your results. It opens when you join a plan.
training.unlocksAfter: Opens after you view your results.

profile.title: Profile
profile.help: The more we know about you, the better we can help. Only your name, phone and date of birth are needed to start.
profile.complete: Your profile is complete. Thank you.
profile.emptyText: Add a few details so we can personalise your training.

eligibility.help: The world competition is for competitors aged 22 or younger in the competition year. This is only an estimate from your date of birth. [TODO-MO: confirm the local Qatar rule] Check your local selection rules.
eligibility.missing: Add your date of birth to see the last year you can enter the competition.
